chapter.verse: Tua ahih ciangin upa ahi tham loin, Khazih’ gimna thuakna a mu teci hi a, a kilang ding vangliatna a zom ding keimah in note lakah a om upate kong hansuah hi.
Note lakah a om Pasian’ tuu honte cin’ nading thu panin, zawhthawhna tawh cing loin, a siangtho lo sum hauh nading hi loin, hehpihna lungsim tawh,
atuam atuam na uk uh pawlpite, aana tawh hi loin, tuu honte maiah na pumpi uh limpha suakin, Pasian’ deihna bangin na cing un.
Tua bang ahih leh, Tuucing Ukpa hong kilat ciangin note in, a vul thei lo vangliatna lukhu na ngah ding uh hi.

Tua mah bangin khangnote aw, a khan’ sawt upate ukna na mang un. Ahi hi. Note khempeuh in khat leh khat na kizep nadingun kiniamsakna na silh un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, “Pasian in a kisatheite a kham hi; a lungniamsakte kiangah hehpihna thupha a pia hi.”
Tua ahih ciangin a hun a cin’ ciangin Pasian in note hong pahtawi nadingin, ama khut vanglian nuai-ah na kiniamsak un.
Pasian in note hong keem ahih ciangin, na lunghihmawhna khempeuh uh ama tungah na koih un.
Kipin kikeem un. Kikepna tawh na ngak un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, na gal uh ahi Dawimangpa in a hawk thei humpinelkai bangin kua mi ka ne ding hiam ci-in zong kawikawi-in a om hi.
Leitung mun khempeuhah a om na u na naute un tua bang gimna thuakin a om uh hi ci-in thei un la, upna tawh kipin Dawimangpa na nial un.
Khazih hangin note, ama vangliat tawntung minthan’na ah hong sam, hehpihna thupha khempeuh’ Pasian in tawlkhat gimna na thuak khit uh ciangin, hong cingsak, hong kipsak, hong khauhsak ding hi.
Tua Pasian in a tawntungin vangliatna nei ta hen. Amen.

Keimah in note hong hansuahin, hih thute in Pasian’ hehpihna thupha thu a man takpi ahi ci-in teci pangin hih lai a tomin ka gelh khit ciangin, midik ka sak sanggampa Silvanas’ khut sung pan ka hong pia hi.Tua sungah na kip un.
Ka tapa Marka akipan Babilon khuapi sungah a om note tawh a kiteel khawm pawlpite in note hong hopih uh hi.
Khat leh khat ki-itna napna tawh kihopih un. Khazih sungah a om note khempeuh tungah nopna om ta hen.
